home.heroTitle: Smart Procurement. Less Waiting. Better Farming.
home.heroDesc: Book guaranteed procurement slots, monitor live centre queues from home, track quality inspection, and receive direct payment status updates from one transparent platform.
home.service1Desc: Book your arrival slot in advance and avoid long lines at the market yard.
home.service2Desc: Monitor live counter tokens in real time and leave home at the optimal time.
home.service3Desc: Intelligent automated suggestions for lowest-congestion time slots.
home.service4Desc: Instant verifiable digital token issued with appointment reference.
home.service5Desc: Transparent visibility into weighing, quality grade, and accepted quantity.
home.service6Desc: Direct-to-bank account payment status tracking and transaction references.
home.step1Desc: Quick one-time registration with basic farmer details and masked Aadhaar.
home.step2Desc: Pick your nearest procurement centre with smart low-congestion suggestions.
home.step3Desc: Instant digital token with QR code for streamlined centre check-in.
home.step4Desc: Follow real-time token movement and travel only when your turn is near.
home.step5Desc: Produce weighed, quality graded, and approved with instant digital receipts.
home.step6Desc: Monitor direct bank deposit status with official payment references.
